answer: Fund it at the root: before a key earns, the ledger taints the capital that seeded it. Each newcomer's first inbound transfer is walked one hop back to its funding parent, and the parent's hop again, building a shallow provenance thread. A hundred puppets hung from one juniper share the same root, so their claimed independence collapses into a single trunk; honest agents draw from scattered, unrelated sources and their taint branches diverge fast. Where many fresh keys hang off one knoll of origin, weight is withheld until each proves an external funding edge.
